segments.text: Now, let's get to it and check the library out ourselves.
We are now at the main door.
Right before we get in the library through the turnstile gates, you can see a set of
computers on your left.
They can only be used to log on to your library account, so you can browse for items or check
your borrowing status.
These computers used to be right next to the turnstiles inside the library, but we've
moved them, so you don't need to bring your student card to browse for books.
Right, do you all have your student cards here? Good! Let's get past these
turnstiles. Alright, as you can see, right in the middle of the floor is our help
desk. Many of your questions regarding the library can be answered here, but
remember that our staff are only available until 6.30 p.m. On both sides
of the helpdesk just across the paths are the self-service machines which I've just mentioned.
The only way for you to borrow and return items is using these machines. If you walk along the
left path from the turnstiles you'll end up in the reference room where you can find new magazines
and journals for reference. This is a read-only room which means you cannot take any items out.
Now let's take the right path toward the lift and stairs at the end. Walking past the help desk,
you can see on your right the print hub where you can print, scan, or make copies of the materials
you need. The room after that next to the stairs is the supply room. Let's get to the stairs and
advance to the next level.
